title: auth.ListApiKeyItem
description:
An API key with metadata and accumulated cost information.

This extends [`ApiKeyWithMetadata`](super::ApiKeyWithMetadata) with
the total cost incurred by requests using this key.

cost.description: The total cost incurred by this API key.

created.description: The timestamp when the API key was created (RFC 3339 format).

description.description: The user-provided description of the API key, or `None` if not provided.

disabled.description: The timestamp when the API key was disabled, or `None` if it is active.

expires.description: The timestamp when the API key expires, or `None` if it does not expire.

name.description: The user-provided name of the API key.
